title: Sorting, Searching & Common Patterns
intro: Build the sorting and searching foundations expected in Python fresher interviews through 21 focused lessons. Trace bubble, selection, and insertion sort from their invariants; use Python's stable built-in sorting correctly; search with linear and binary boundaries; and apply opposite-end, same-direction, sliding-window, palindrome, anagram, and efficient string-building patterns. Every lesson includes precise revision points, a complete interview answer, and an independent visual Deep Dive with executable Python.
